newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures plop back down, end lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures plop back down, end lower.

text.p: Jan 15 - U.S. stock index futures ricocheted back down, ended lower. Traders said late erosion in T-bond futures at their close, some options-related positioning before Friday's Jan options expiry, added weight. They also said activity was erratic, mainly thin and mostly local. March S&Ps broke below then returned above support near 768.60, held 767.00.
